def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[i] == 5 for row in grid))
    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep+1:] for row in grid]

            if left[r][c] != bg and right[r][c] != next(v for v in set(sum(right, [])) if v != right_fg):
                out[r][c] = 3
    return out
